narrationTexts: Confirmed the bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js:39` charges tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount. Fixing it.
finalText:
**Fixed. All 625 tests pass.**

`orderTotal` in [pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.

Changed it to apply tax after the discount, matching the spec in `cases.js`.

Next: nothing, suite is green.
